verdict.rationale: Bruno's first-party site explicitly states 'No cloud sync. No account. No login. We have zero visibility into your requests, and we're not training AI models on your data,' meaning there is no telemetry/usage tracking to begin with, satisfying the privacy-posture story by design rather than via an opt-out toggle. Missing for 10: no explicit telemetry settings/toggle documentation, and no independent code audit or hands-on verification confirming absence of any tracking calls.
